results.title: Paradip Port achieves 150 MT annual cargo handling milestone; Rs 21,000 crore port planned in Ganjam
results.description: Odisha 's Paradip Port has achieved a major milestone by reaching an annual cargo handling capacity of 150 million metric tonnes, Union Minister for Ports , Shipping and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal said during his visit to the port on Friday. The minister also inaugurated and laid foundation stones for seven major projects worth Rs 427.80 crore. The port is now aiming to significantly expand its capacity, with a target of handling 500 million metric tonnes of cargo annually. The Centre has also planned a greenfield port at Bahuda in Ganjam district at an estimated cost of Rs 21,000 crore, which is expected to handle around five million containers. Paradip Sets Sights On 500 MT Target Sonowal credited the Odisha government and people for helping Paradip Port achieve the milestone and said the port has demonstrated its strength as one of the country’s most powerful ports. “With the help of the Odisha government and the people, Paradip Port has achieved a milestone and proved that it is the most powerful port in the country. Our next target will be 500 million metric tonnes per annum,” Sonowal said. The minister inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for seven projects at the port as part of efforts to strengthen its infrastructure and cargo handling capacity. Development Push For Odisha’s Maritime Sector Jagatsinghpur MP Bibhu Prasad Tarai said the programme also highlighted the port’s recent achievements and the development initiatives undertaken in the area. He congratulated youths who received appointment letters for new jobs during the minister’s visit. “I congratulate the youths who received their appointment letters today for their new jobs from the minister. The programme was aimed at highlighting the achievements of Paradip Port in recent times. Various MoUs were signed, and the minister has also assured us that the development of the port will continue,” Tarai said. Odisha Industries, Skill Development and Technical Education Minister Sampad Chandra Swain said the initiatives were aimed at accelerating the growth of both Paradip Port and Odisha. Also Read: Paradip Port Handles Highest Volume Of Cargo In Country During First Quarter Of Current Fiscal “The programmes held here today were aimed at making Paradip Port and Odisha grow. Ships carrying heavy logistics will also be able to anchor at Paradip Port, and the port can now handle more cargo,” Swain said. Bahuda Greenfield Port Planned The proposed Rs 21,000-crore greenfield port at Bahuda is expected to handle five million containers and further strengthen Odisha’s maritime infrastructure.

results.title: Scoreless through 9, Rangers win 2-1 over Angels when Langford has tying RBI and winning run in 10th
results.description: Wyatt Langford had a tying RBI double in the 10th inning, then scored the winning run on third baseman Denzer Guzman’s throwing error as the Texas Rangers beat the Los Angeles Angels 2-1. Guzman had opened the top of the 10th Friday night with an RBI double to put the Angels ahead in the eighth MLB this season that was scoreless going into extra innings. With two outs in the bottom of the 10th after an intentional walk, Guzman made a nice stop on a grounder by Ezequiel Duran. But his wide throw to second base trying to get an inning-ending forceout allowed Langford to race home.
